## Proposed change
This PR changes the availability of the Wallbox Pause/Resume switch. Before it was only available when the wallbox was in a few  select statusses. As new statusses have been added by Wallbox this causes issues for users where the switch would be unavailable. This PR reverses the logic and makes it unavailable for a few select statusses and available in all other cases.

issue_context.title: Wallbox Integration Pause/Resume not available on status Waiting in Queue
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The Wallbox integration 'Pause/resume' entity is "unavailable" in Home assistant outside the hours set in a schedule in the Wallbox app. This is despite the fact that the charge can be paused/resumed through the app (effectively overriding the schedule). The Homebridge Wallbox integration is also able to override the schedule, so it should be technically possible and the current way the home assistant integration works is not was is the intended functionality of Wallbox.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.7.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Wallbox

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/wallbox/

review_comments: I think yes for `unknown`, `error` and `disconnected` but why should the others render it `unavailable`?

its a switch that allows you to pause/unpause the charging. You can only do that if; the car is connected (not READY or DISCONNECTED, means unconnected), not locked (needs unlocking before you can charge) and not updating (wouldn't be safe). This replicates the way the wallbox app functions.
